ValidationRule.description: This VR will not allow Service user to create PEO Billable project
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.ProjectValidations__c != true, ISNEW(), pse__Is_Template__c = false, OR( $Profile.Name = 'PEO Service', $Profile.Name = 'BPS Service', $Profile.Name = 'Retirement Services', $Profile.Name = 'Contact Center' ), RecordType.DeveloperName = 'PEO_Project_Billable' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot create PEO Billable Projects.
